fact: The National Social Security Authority of Zimbabwe (NSSA) says pensioners can now receive their pension payments straight into a mobile money wallet.
system: NSSA pension mobile money wallet payment

fact: Minister July Moyo said the ministry selected NetOne after a competition to carry the Urban Cash Transfer programme for 1.7 million urban people, loaded ministry cash into the network provider the previous week, and expected recipients to start receiving money to their phone numbers that week.
system: Urban Cash Transfer and Movement of Grain Programme via NetOne

fact: Gemnation reports that the Harmonised Social Cash Transfer programme uses electronic payments (EcoCash) instead of cash in transit, with 75,000 beneficiary households registered in 30 districts.
Cabinet's briefing says NetOne has been contracted to pay urban beneficiaries under the Urban-Cash-for-Cereal Programme, with payments expected to start by the end of that week.
